scope: Source-verified readiness only; no generator invocation and no measured QA accuracy

protocol.evidence_availability: every selected source must pass representation checks; missing text/image is an error, never silently removed
protocol.oracle_selection: positive qrel IDs sorted lexically, first five
protocol.retrieved_selection: actual frozen retrieval/rerank ranking first five; no gold filtering
protocol.reference_policy: published canonical answer only; raw_answers are not certified alternate references
protocol.explicit_certified_multigold_policy: maximum EM and maximum token F1 independently across references
protocol.lexical_normalization: Unicode NFKC; language-aware Turkish dotted/dotless I; casefold; Unicode punctuation to spaces; whitespace tokens; no article stripping
protocol.citation_metric: positive qrel source-ID set overlap; not entailment or claim-support correctness
protocol.frozen_generator_prompt_settings_and_evi: required before generation; no runner executed

collections.raw_source_binding: supplied query parquet SHA256 set equals frozen manifest /queries/ source SHA256 set; exact query/answer matching below
collections.source_asset_verification: frozen prepared-file hashes and asset inventory; media bytes must be validated before generator use
